review_notes: I read the whole file. I compared its simp lemmas (`smul_mk_apply`, `smul_isUnit`, `smul_eq_mul`, `val_smul`, `smul_inv`, `coe_smul`, `coe_inv_smul`) with the global lemmas `smul_inv`, `smul_inv'` and `smul_eq_mul`, and with downstream uses in Mathlib. I found no loops and no competing rules: `val_smul` and `coe_smul` apply to different `SMul` instances, and `Units.smul_inv` is not a duplicate of the global `smul_inv`, which is not simp and is for groups. One finding: `smul_isUnit` has no `to_additive`, while its siblings `smul_def` and `smul_mk_apply` do. `Units.smul_def` is passed to `simp` by hand in many files (about 113 occurrences). I did not recommend making it simp, because that could conflict with `smul_isUnit` and `smul_mk_apply`, and unfolding every unit action may not suit every use. I could not run Lean. I also could not check which `SMul Mˣ Mˣ` instance `Units.smul_eq_mul` elaborates to, so I left that unreported.

findings.excerpt: lemma smul_isUnit [Monoid M] [SMul M α] {m : M} (hm : IsUnit m) (a : α) : hm.unit • a = m • a := rfl
findings.problem: The simp lemma `smul_isUnit` has no `@[to_additive]`. The file's convention is to give every `Units` smul rewrite an `AddUnits` twin: `smul_def` and `smul_mk_apply` both carry `to_additive`, and so does `IsUnit.inv_smul`. As a result, `IsAddUnit.addUnit hm +ᵥ a` has no simp lemma rewriting it to `m +ᵥ a`, although the `SMul Mˣ α` instance has an additive version. A grep of Mathlib finds no hand-written additive counterpart.
findings.proposed_change: Write the attribute line as `@[to_additive, simp]`. The generated name would be `AddUnits.vadd_isAddUnit`, and `to_additive` should derive the additive statement automatically. Give it a docstring or explicit name if the auto-generated one is unsatisfactory.
findings.benefit: Additive users get the same normal form as multiplicative users: `hm.addUnit +ᵥ a` simplifies to `m +ᵥ a` without a manual `unfold` or `Units.vadd_def`. This also removes an asymmetry between the multiplicative and additive simp sets.

evidence.excerpt: @[to_additive] lemma smul_def [Monoid M] [SMul M α] (m : Mˣ) (a : α) : m • a = (m : M) • a := rfl
